description: Na₃ReO₅ crystallizes in the trigonal P3_121 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.48 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.76 Å. Re is bonded in a trigonal bipyramidal geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Re-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.85 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Re atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Re atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Re atom.
